old_problem: The Procedure references the preceding rocBLAS/AGFHC max-power workload while the FAIL criterion says rocHPL. The row also hard-codes sparse AGT indices and leaves cap/TDP sources, consistency math, sample completeness and platform envelope undefined; DeepSeek replaces the required 50 ms stream with a peak read.
disposition_reason: Retain Pending and Source Conflict only for the irreducible workload identity. rocBLAS and rocHPL exercise materially different kernels, so ED-10/ED-15/ED-20/ED-30 do not permit choosing one or treating them as equivalent. All other gaps are resolved as signed runtime configuration: immutable GPU-to-AGT mapping, exact tools, per-GPU TDP/cap and consistency math, complete 50 ms evidence, cooling/PSU limits, health deltas and one-run recovery.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2065, same-row DeepSeek, GPT V2, historical record, unique-code result and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2066 / Wistron-AMD SVM-00020-V003 / b3444f235f374dea was directly read from XLSX and locked queue.
rocBLAS GEMM-style and rocHPL LINPACK-style workloads are not interchangeable; no approved source precedence resolves the literal Procedure/Criteria conflict.
A peak read cannot prove `consistently` or minimum >=90% TDP; every mapped GPU needs complete 50 ms samples over the exact workload window and signed aggregation math.
Hard-coded AGT indices must be bound to immutable UUID/BDF identities without reducing all-device coverage.
Full-system power requires approved PSU/cooling/ambient/fan limits, complete health deltas and stop-on-gap/fault/limit without retry.
No AGT/AGFHC/rocHPL/rocBLAS/rocm-smi run, stress, log clear, recovery or DUT action was performed.
